spec.headline: In pooled credit, the primary failure mode is contagion.
spec.subhead: Containing shortfalls to individual positions protects broader capital.

blocks.text: Shared Pool: A localized liquidation fracture transmits bad debt across communal reserves.
Segmented Bulkhead: Structural isolation arrests default shortfalls strictly within the position.
Confining losses to individual boundaries prevents balance dilution.

focal.reason: Draws immediate attention to the bulkhead architecture that halts default propagation.

defects.issue: Severe bottom-half dead space causing vertical canvas imbalance
defects.reason: All text and comparison modules are compressed into the top 600px of the frame, leaving roughly 480px of pure empty background at the bottom. This results in an accidental, front-loaded composition rather than deliberate negative space.
defects.fix: Vertically distribute the layout: increase margin-top above the comparison block from 32px to 64px, add vertical padding to the comparison block, and drop the concluding sentence down to y=840px with a subtle top border line.

defects.issue: Intended focal element lacks architectural and visual prominence
defects.reason: The 'Segmented Bulkhead' element is styled merely as plain paragraph text separated by a thin vertical divider. It does not visually register as the intended primary focal element over the headline or surrounding copy.
defects.fix: Wrap the 'Segmented Bulkhead' column in a dedicated card container with a 1px border at 15% opacity or add a discrete accent tag above it to draw primary focus.

defects.issue: Inline run-in headers weaken comparison scannability
defects.location: Comparison text blocks ('Shared Pool:' and 'Segmented Bulkhead:')
defects.reason: Titles are set inline on the same line as the descriptive body copy, obscuring the category labels during quick scanning.
defects.fix: Separate 'Shared Pool' and 'Segmented Bulkhead' onto their own dedicated heading lines in semibold weight, separated from the descriptive body text by an 8px paragraph gap.
